design_decisions.hotkey: NONE — surfaced via Architect 'Security (방어)' category ONLY, mirroring the fence-gate precedent, to avoid the contended key space (B/F/G/T/Y/N/R/X/M/P/K/J/H/L/E + WASD camera). Hotkey was not required (task allowed 'or surface via Architect only').
design_decisions.pathing: BLOCKS pathing like a low wall. BarricadeEntity reuses the EXISTING wall pathing-block API READ-ONLY (PawnMovement.RegisterWallCell -> PathGrid.SetStructureBlocked(cell,true) in Start; SetStructureBlocked(cell,false) in OnDestroy; EjectPawnsFromCell on build). NO new pathfinding invented. This is the DELIBERATE inverse of FenceEntity (which is passable, no collider, no PathGrid registration).
design_decisions.sortingOrder: 2 — LOW barrier read (above floors @1, below furniture/walls @5+), same as fence.
design_decisions.collider: 1x1 BoxCollider2D on the prefab so CellOccupied's OverlapBox detects it (no stacking / no blueprint-on-top), same as WallEntity. Pathing block is via PathGrid, not the collider.
design_decisions.no_cover_math: Confirmed NONE. Barricade is visual + pathing only (cover-math is gated/over-scope). A future cover wave can add accuracy math without touching BarricadeEntity.

bug_firewall: No baked-in lesson re-introduced.
